title: The Base Grant Where the Employer's Cafe Counter Sets the Pace
content:
The grant an Employee Meal Account starts from is read against what the employer's own counter at that site funds. The counter in question is the one run under the Workplace Cafe Management Program contract at the account's site, and the figure read from it is the subsidy that contract's service model publishes for one employee in one service day. The suspended counter share is 40 percent.

**Clause.** Where the employer's cafe programme at the account's site stands active and the subsidy it publishes for one employee in one service day is below the grant amount printed against the plan, the base grant is that published daily subsidy, since the employer funds no more than it buys at its own counter. Where the employer's cafe programme at the account's site stands suspended and it publishes a daily subsidy at all, the base grant is the printed grant amount taken at the suspended counter share, rounded to two decimal places at that step. Where neither holds, the base grant is the grant amount printed against the plan.

## The grant amount this is read against, plan by plan

| Meal plan | Grant amount printed against the plan |
|---|---|
| Pay-As-You-Go Badge Account | $0.00 |
| Prepaid Declining Balance Account | $0.00 |
| Payroll Deduction Meal Account | $0.00 |
| Subsidized Daily Allowance Account | $9.50 |
| Full Subsidy Employee Meal Account | $18.00 |
| Executive Dining Charge Account | $420.00 |

## The bands

| The cafe contract at the account's site | Daily subsidy it publishes per employee | The base grant |
|---|---|---|
| Active | Below the grant amount printed against the plan | That published daily subsidy |
| Active | At or above the printed grant amount | The grant amount printed against the plan |
| Suspended | Above nothing | 40 percent of the printed grant amount |
| Suspended | Nothing published | The grant amount printed against the plan |
| Closed, or none held at the site | Any | The grant amount printed against the plan |

*Hypothetical illustration.* On a plan printing a grant amount of $18.00, an active cafe contract publishing $14.00 a day gives a base grant of $14.00, while one publishing $20.00 a day leaves the base grant at $18.00. Where that same contract stands suspended but still publishes a daily subsidy, the base grant is $18.00 taken at 40 percent, or $7.20.
